ItemID: NA; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My recent interest in Old Sock makes this relaxed blues-rock tribute especially appealing; this is my pick today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Step Back; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blues guitar fits my interest in People, Hell & Angels, but I would save this for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Let Me Get By; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its blues and roots sound interests me, though I am only choosing one album today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Croz; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The reflective songwriting appeals to the side of my taste suggested by You Should Be So Lucky, but it is not my first choice.
ItemID: NA; Title: Heaven & Earth; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in blues and roots music than progressive rock right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Endless River; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: An atmospheric, largely instrumental album does not match my current mood for songs and blues guitar.
ItemID: NA; Title: Don Henley Cass County; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: My interest in Blown Away makes country material relevant, but I am leaning toward blues today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Rattle That Lock; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The guitar-led rock is appealing, but I am not interested enough to choose a second album.
ItemID: NA; Title: Plain Spoken; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Roots-oriented songwriting sounds appealing alongside my recent listening, though I would leave it for later.
ItemID: NA; Title: Led Zeppelin; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blues-based rock fits my Hendrix interest, but the title alone gives me little reason to choose it over The Breeze.
